title: nan
authors: Phillips G.; Bradley J.; Ganesh P.
key_contribution: Presents the REEF Estimator, a modular GPS-denied state estimation system adapted to the Ardupilot flight stack and containerized for deployment on NDAA-compliant multi-rotor vehicles.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
